points.why: Names Escalation and describes each vendor's balancing loop toward a relative target combining into a reinforcing loop.
Explains that developers keep rewarding the bigger free tier, so a unilateral cut just cedes ground to the rival.
Proposes structural fixes: a mutually binding verifiable limit, a new dimension to compete on, and making free tier less decisive, explicitly not willpower.

pitfalls.why: Explicitly says there is no natural ceiling and that only cost limits the spiral.
